about: The reality check: what real videos measured, and the game run in the same conditions. Read by tools/video/reality_check.py. Every real value comes from Documentation/reports/video/ and the Claude Doc 'Windsurf video analysis'. 'strict' cases pass or fail; the others are shown but cannot fail the check, because the game's conditions do not match the video's well enough yet. Gear: the game's own brands, the nearest to the videos' gear (pj_new_sealand_slalom_97 = 97 l like the JP Slalom 62.5; pj_new_sealand_slalom_117 for the 72 board; gg_sails_slalom_5_7 for the 5.6 race sail; nielstrots_slalom_7_4 for the 7.4).

cases.what: Rig rake back from upright, straight at full speed
cases.source: videos 04 (side view, 30-40 kn, 62 board + 5.6) and 08 (side view at water level, 20-25 kn, 72 + 7.4): 33-36 deg in the picture, about 31 deg once the 24 deg windward lean is taken out
cases.note: the game's rake is a share of max_rake_deg (25 deg on both gear sails)

cases.what: Rig lean to windward, straight at full speed
cases.source: video 07 (front view, 15-20 kn, 72 + 7.4, a close reach): 23-29 deg in the picture, about 24 deg once the rake is taken out
cases.note: the game's straight case is a beam reach, the video a close reach

cases.what: Wet length of the hull at full speed, from the tail
cases.source: videos 04 (0.5-0.7 m, 30-40 kn) and 06 (about 0.5 m, 20-25 kn), side views scaled by the board's length
video 07 (front view): about level, within about 5 deg

cases.what: Time off the plane in a gybe at full speed (planing ratio under 0.5)
cases.source: videos 01 (35 kn) and 02 (20-25 kn): the board planes through the gybe, flip about 0.6 s; only video 03's deliberately slow gybe drops off the plane
cases.note: tests the controller's gybe as well as the physics

cases.what: Board pitch changes over chop (spread of the changes faster than 1 s)
cases.source: video 04 (side view, 30-40 kn, dense chop, 313 frames against the beach line): 1.5-1.9 deg
cases.note: not strict: the game's chop is the lake's at its own wind (about 15-18 kt), the video's is Gruissan's at 30-40 kn; the real wave height is not measured

cases.what: How much the legs give over chop (spread of the changes faster than 1 s)
cases.source: video 07 (front view, 15-20 kn, low chop), read by the body tracker on every frame (tools/video/pose_track.py, 26 Nov 2026, 459 frames): the hips' distance from the feet changes 1.6 cm (2.3 with the tracker's jitter), the hips' height above the feet 3.0 cm. The 5 cm of 25 Nov (front_bounce.py) followed the board's nose, which pitches
cases.note: not strict: one camera. The real body moves 0.71 of the board at the feet (correlation 0.58); the game at 0.4 Hz / 0.4 0.91-1.10 against the board (correlation -0.27 to -0.56: the body bobs against it); 0.6-0.8 Hz at damping 1.0 fit best (Documentation/reports/reality_fixes/PROGRESS.md, 'The body tracker'). The sailor rides on legs in heave (SailorBody, a spring and damper, PHYSICS_SPEC.md 7.5); legs that give in pitch and roll are still missing (backlog E01.S07 T1)

cases.what: Board speed straight at full power on race gear
cases.source: Max, 26 Nov 2026: the videos' speeds are roughly 30-35 kn (01-08: 62 + 5.6 in 20-40 kn, 72 + 7.4 in 15-25 kn of wind)
cases.note: NOT STRICT, indicative only: the videos are in real chop and neither the game's flat water nor its sea matches it (Max, 26 Nov); fair only once the game's chop is real; Max, 26 Nov 2026 (Q53): with good timing in small chop almost no speed is lost; in big swell and chop a lot: at Sotavento 50-55 going out against the waves and 65+ coming in on a downwind reach (read as km/h: about 27-30 against 35+ kn)
